Reminders about gate queues in detail
A hardworking afternoon is easier when you know what to expect
Companion Animal Travel Desk guide for large dog travel

Our desk keeps the process steady and simple. Bring the right papers, keep your animal calm, and check your crate and leash setup before you head to the airport. The welcome team will look for clear labels, safe handling, and a clean travel setup that fits the trip.

Health paperwork matters most. <<FACT F081>> Keep it with your travel documents so screening moves along without delay. If your dog seems nervous, give yourself extra space in the queue and use a calm voice. Crew members can help with basic direction, but the traveler stays responsible for comfort and control.

Fees and acceptance rules also need a quick review. <<FACT F057>> If you are unsure whether your setup is suitable, ask the desk before you arrive at the gate. That keeps surprises off the board and helps the safety coordinator review the trip without slowing the line.

For the smoothest handoff, keep food, water, and cleaning supplies easy to reach. Make sure the leash is secure, the crate is sound, and the animal can stand and turn around comfortably. If you are traveling with more than one companion animal, plan for extra handling and follow the crew's instructions closely.

If anything looks unclear, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before departure for the latest guidance.
